issues.explanation: Same changelog bullet is duplicated under released [0.0.0]; released sections are immutable, the entry belongs under [Unreleased] only.
Database-schema write-once note lists only called_at and called_by_user_id as mutable, omitting status which the model and business-rules correctly allow.
nextCode treats codes as valid only up to 18 digits while the task defines valid as A followed by digits without a length cap; no practical impact at realistic volumes.

conventions.evidence: Domain write via app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:51, reversible migrations with down() (2026_10_01_000001:456, 2026_10_01_000002:497), Fillable guards (app/Models/Queue.php:164, app/Models/Ticket.php:212), docs updated; deviation: CHANGELOG.md:17 duplicates Unreleased entry under released [0.0.0]

readability.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:68 issue(), app/Models/Ticket.php:277 nextCode(), app/Models/Ticket.php:309 call() are small with clear names and comments; no dead code or debug output

requirements.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:51 locks queue row (72), rejects stale/inactive with InactiveQueueException, retries collisions 5x (45,60); app/Models/Ticket.php:277 nextCode uses insertion-order scan, handles A999->A1000->A1001, deletion no-reuse, malformed skip; app/Models/Ticket.php:309 single member-only call; migrations unique (queue_id,code) and index (queue_id,status,priority,issued_at)

scope.evidence: Diff touches only queues/tickets domain: 2 migrations, Queue/Ticket/Entity, 2 enums, 1 exception, IssueTicket, 2 factories, 2 docs, CHANGELOG, 1 test file; no unrelated refactors or features

security.evidence: app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:72 lockForUpdate fresh is_active check; app/Models/Ticket.php:314 membership check throws AuthorizationException before any write, fresh lockForUpdate status check (320), Fillable excludes called_* with forceFill only for allowed fields (327)

simplicity.evidence: Lean direct Eloquent: queue lock + nextCode + create, updating-event write-once guard, per-insert factory code allocation; no service/repository layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/TicketIssuanceTest.php:642 first code/defaults, 657 per-queue sequence, 674 stale-queue rejection, 690 insertion order, 698 delete no-reuse, 708 malformed skip, 746 member call-once, 776 non-member AuthorizationException with unchanged ticket, 788 cascade delete

review.summary: Adds queues/tickets persistence, per-queue A001 codes, IssueTicket with row-lock and retry, write-once tickets and member-only single call, with comprehensive Pest tests and synced docs. Requirements, security, tests, simplicity, readability and scope are strong; only nits remain around changelog placement and minor doc wording, so approve with nits.
